ArrivalDef.description: Where a trip may build a portal in the dimension when none is near (realm portal spec, "Building a portal").

floor.description: The block under and in front of a frame carved out where no spot fits, e.g. minecraft:stone_bricks. It drops as usual.
floor.title: Floor

pocket_radius.description: Blocks of safe space around a carved frame, free of fluids and falling blocks (3 by default).
pocket_radius.title: Pocket Radius

y.description: [lowest, highest]: the heights a built frame's bottom row may stand at, which keep arrivals in the depth band of the realm's lowest levels; Overworld [64, 310], above sea level.
y.title: Y

ArrivalDef.title: ArrivalDef

LocalizedText.description: A player-facing text, keyed by locale. Realmforge ships English only, so en_us is the one locale.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

description: A realm: its dimension, what players read about it, the icon of its unlock, and its portal.

arrival.description: Where a trip may build a portal in the dimension.

colour.description: The portal's colour while it opens onto the realm, e.g. #7A8FB0; Overworld's: return portals.
colour.title: Colour

description.description: The realm as a plain description in running text, lowercase and without an article: stone realm. The refusal at the sealstone reads 'a portal to the stone realm' (Matěj, 2026-10-20). Every realm has one; Overworld none.

dimension.description: The realm's dimension, e.g. realmforge:stone (content/worldgen/); minecraft:overworld for Overworld's entry, which is no realm.
dimension.title: Dimension

flavour.description: A flavour line, shown on the first arrival and with the unlock: one sentence, no mechanics. Every realm has one; Overworld none.

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

icon.description: The item the unlock advancement shows, e.g. one of the realm's blocks. Every realm has one; Overworld none.
icon.title: Icon

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

levels.description: [lowest, highest]: the realm's level band, which the arrival title shows (RLM-139); the lowest is the entry level its dimension rules floor mobs at, the highest at most their max_level. Every realm has one; Overworld none.
levels.title: Levels

locked_hint.description: How to unlock it, shown when a player without the unlock is refused: one sentence naming the quest, 'Unlocked by completing The Ominous Chief quest.' Every realm has one; Overworld none.

name.description: The realm's name, without an article: Undervault (RLM-188).

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

particle.description: The vanilla particle the portal shows next to the dust in its colour, one without options: minecraft:ash. Every realm has one; Overworld none.
particle.title: Particle

anyOf.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

signet.description: The item from content/items/ that opens the realm portal onto the realm, stacking to 1: realmforge:undervault_signet. Every realm has its own; Overworld none.
signet.title: Signet

sound_pitch.description: The pitch of the vanilla portal sounds for this realm until our own sounds exist (A3): 0.5-2.
sound_pitch.title: Sound Pitch

subtitle.description: Its element, shown with the name where a player first meets it: Stone Realm (RLM-139). Every realm has one; Overworld none.

title: RealmDef
